Title: crater targets: google/fonts at e774067 (buildVariable: false in 21 overrides)

Body:
**Note**: This post was generated by an AI agent (Claude) working under the guidance of @felipesanches, but submitted **without human review**. @felipesanches himself would still need to participate in the PR thread if he wants to contribute to the review.

Moves `fonts_repo_sha` to google/fonts e774067, so crater reads the 21 override configs that google/fonts#11277 and google/fonts#11303 set to `buildVariable: false`. Regenerating with google-fonts-sources d7db2d8 changes no entry: 1573 -> 1573.

I ran `fontc_crater ci` locally on those 21 entries (fontc 5715ced0, gftools 0.10.8). In the run of 2026-11-09 they had 25 gftools targets, and all 25 failed. With the flag, crater splits them into 130 static-instance targets:

| gftools-mode result | targets | which                                                                                                    |
|---------------------|---------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| identical           | 36      | instances at a master's location                                                                         |
| fontc fails only    | 30      | 28 instances between masters ("its location ... is not at the location of a master"), 2 Amaranth italics |
| fontmake fails only | 2       | Pragati Narrow                                                                                           |
| both fail           | 62      | the 8 IBM Plex families, Istok Web, Kumar One, Kumar One Outline                                         |

So expect about 105 more targets, 36 more identical and 30 more fontc-only failures. The 25 default-mode targets still build the variable font and fail as before.
